units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:7:8">Y. Yoma VIII, end, 45ᶜ</cite> <he>ותִסְלַח לי על וכ׳</he> and forgive me all my sins.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:28">Num. R. s. 16</cite>, end <he>בשבילך אֶסְלַח להם</he> for thy sake I will pardon them. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27 <he>וסָלַחְתִּי כדבריך</he> and I pardoned (Israel) according to thy word; a. fr.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 755">Yalk. Ps. 755</cite> <he>ונ׳ לו</he> (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII</cite> <he>ומתכפר</he>) and he is forgiven.
